ns2:section.sectionText: *Students must register for the Lecture and one Discussion section. Students who have completed ADV 283 (SP23 or before) should not register for ADV 250. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. The course is currently restricted to students who started their collegiate coursework prior to or in Fall 2023. This restriction will be lifted to allow Fall 2024 first-year ADV and CS+ADV majors to begin registering on November 20 by 12pm. Students who are planning to apply to transfer into Advertising for Spring 2025 will not be able to register for ADV 250 until they have been admitted into the major. There are NO exceptions. If spaces are still available in this course in January, newly admitted ICT transfers will be allowed to register after admission notifications are sent out. Due to major and transfer demand, seats will not open to the general campus population.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising or Computer Science & Advertising major(s).
